input.quote: 11.1 Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
input.rationale: Sections 11.2 and 11.3 give us a compliant 30-day machine-readable data return and certified deletion, but Section 11.1 sits in walk-away territory: it requires immediate cessation of all assistance and permanent deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support, and as the first-listed provision it directly contradicts (and could be read to override) 11.2/11.3. There is no transition-assistance period at all, so the clause fails even the fallback (90 days of assistance). We replaced 11.1 with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates and made deletion subject to the 11.2/11.3 return and certification mechanics, which reaches the preferred position with the smallest edit; 90 days remains an acceptable fallback.

ops.oldText: Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: On expiry or termination of this Agreement or an Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance (including export and migration support) for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates, and shall not delete Customer Data except in accordance with Sections 11.2 and 11.3.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We replaced the immediate cut-off and deletion language with up to six months of transition assistance at your then-current rates, since our playbook requires an orderly exit and this drafting also contradicted the data-return and certified-deletion mechanics in 11.2 and 11.3. We can work with 90 days of assistance if that is easier operationally.
proposal.summary: Replace immediate-deletion/no-assistance clause with six-month transition assistance at then-current rates, subject to 11.2/11.3 return and deletion.
